properties.name: A write that makes another claim read refuted says so in its reply, and how to keep the two as a dispute instead
properties.source: @ajs, 2026-10-18: "Capture the shortcomings (gaps) from the trial" (cogito AI branch)
properties.statement:
When an edge or claim written changes another claim's reading to refuted (or defeated), the write's reply names that claim and its new reading. When the writer's own evidence or note calls it a dispute, the reply says how to record it as one (a mutual attack, or a Decision kept `contested`).
Observed on 2026-10-18 in the cogito design's AI branch: a chat drew one opposing CONTRADICTS between the functionalist and Cartesian verdicts, with evidence "kept as the open dispute this branch is about". The Cartesian verdict silently became `refuted`. The session made no read-back, so nobody saw it.

ALSO MEASURED 2026-10-19 (trolley trial): with principles taken as given, one opposing CONTRADICTS between rival positions made the TARGET read refuted while the source read shown. Which side "lost" depended only on the edge's direction. There should be a recorded form for "these positions are in open dispute" that reads both as contested, without needing a Decision per question, and the served argument skill should name it.
